handoff.salientSummary: Verified result pagination performance with 10,000+ predictions. EXPLAIN ANALYZE confirmed composite index (evaluation_id, question_index) is used correctly for queries with large OFFSET (9900+). Added test case TestPredictionLargeOffsetPagination that verifies correct pagination at various page boundaries with 10,500 predictions.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Verified and tested result pagination performance. (1) Ran EXPLAIN ANALYZE on pagination query with large OFFSET (9900), confirmed composite index idx_predictions_evaluation_id_question_index is used via Bitmap Index Scan. (2) Added TestPredictionLargeOffsetPagination test case that creates 10,500 predictions and verifies correct pagination at page boundaries (page 1, 50, 100, 105, 200) including correct question_index values.

commandsRun.command: docker exec eval-postgres psql -U eval_user -d evaluations -c "EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM predictions WHERE evaluation_id='8bb55603-42f1-4056-b073-6f805fcd5114' ORDER BY question_index ASC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 9900;"
commandsRun.observation: EXPLAIN ANALYZE shows Bitmap Index Scan on idx_predictions_evaluation_id_question_index (cost=82.45..82.45, actual time=2.961..2.970ms for 100 rows)

commandsRun.command: docker exec eval-postgres psql -U eval_user -d evaluations -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM predictions;"
commandsRun.observation: 10,001 predictions in database (1 from previous test + 10,000 from batch insert)
All tests pass across all packages

cases.name: TestPredictionLargeOffsetPagination
cases.verifies: Large OFFSET pagination with 10,500 predictions at various page offsets (page 1, 50, 100, 105, 200), verifying correct question_index values at each page boundary

tests.coverage: Tests pagination correctness across page boundaries with large result sets including first page (offset 0), middle pages (offset 4900), large offset (offset 9900), last page (offset 10400), and beyond total (empty result)
